$comment: XCH validation cases: expected value, tolerance, unit, source/derivation. Values are (a) quoted from a pinned file (nist_pmi_gvp_reference.json, xch_corpus.json), (b) analytic (analytic_gvp_reference.json, generate_analytic_gvp.py), or (c) TBD with the tool that measures them. Tolerance policy: validation/README.md section 3.

sameKernelRoundTrip.derivation: OCC writes and reads back the same B-rep; only decimal serialization of REAL values intervenes (llull TR-XCH-05 requires >= 15 significant digits)

analyticVsExactKernel.derivation: exact analytic surfaces; residual is BRepGProp numerical integration error, measured <= 1.1e-14 relative at the origin with OCCT 7.9.3 (01 KRN occt_crosscheck.json); aligned with VC-KRN-01 (1e-9)

igesRoundTrip.derivation: provisional: IGES re-import rebuilds solids by sewing at max(file resolution, 1e-6 diag) (TR-XCH-12); replace with a measured bound after VC-XCH-11 runs

importVsEmbeddedGvp.derivation: yellow bound = Dassault Systemes CATIA STEP import default (volume and area ratio < 1 %, centroid deviation < 1 mm), [R14]. Green bound one order tighter, checked against measured sender-vs-OCCT 7.9.3 agreement on the NIST files whose GVP describe their geometry (01 KRN ../../01-exact-brep-kernel/validation/nist_gvp_vs_occt.json): 6 files (ctc_01 e1, ctc_03 e2, ctc_04 e2, ftc_06 e2, stc_10 e2, ftc_09 rd) differ by at most 7.5e-5 volume and 9.4e-4 area (ctc_04 e2) and 0.0064 mm centroid, all green; the 4 gross disagreements (ctc_02 rc / e2, stc_08 e3, ctc_05 rd: >= 1.06e-2 volume) are red. ctc_04 area sits 6 % under the green limit, so 1e-3 must not be tightened without new evidence; ftc_07 e2 (2.1e-4 volume, 3.9e-5 area, 0.021 mm) is green here although 01 KRN VC-KRN-04 (stricter test tolerance 1e-4) flags it. VC-XCH-06 (CTC-02 AP203 vs AP242) is a GVP-to-GVP figure and is not used as justification. CAx-IF three-tier green/yellow/red reporting [R13]. This is the single GVP band policy of llull (01 KRN defers to it).

tessellatedVsExact.derivation: COULD-level heuristic; a faceted body under-estimates curved volume; replace with a chord-tolerance-derived bound once VC-XCH-09 is measured
